Philosophy

Company

Senscat plans, develops, and operates digital services across education, enterprise AI analytics, and consultation operations. We design products together with the operational workflows required to run them.

Sensmath supports math learning, Selene AI Insight analyzes AI usage and subscription costs, and Senstaro helps tarot consultants create and share readings with customers.

We prioritize privacy, stable operation, and continuous improvement based on real user feedback.

Focus

Service planning

We define user flows, data needs, and operating policies.

Operation

Continuous operation

We improve services through real usage data and feedback.
